title: Ham Contact Log and Grid Coverage
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham-radio stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=aprs:packet
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats dc(grid) as grids, dc(callsign) as stations, count as contacts by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts the distinct map grid squares and stations your station worked each month, gamifying your on-air activity.
value: Grid-square chasing is a favourite ham pastime; a monthly coverage count keeps the collection growing and the hobby fun.
implementation: Ingest station contacts into `index=personal`; schedule monthly and count distinct grids and stations.
visualization: Column chart of grids and stations worked per month.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many different map areas and stations you contacted by radio each month, like collecting them.
